camera.manualOverride: forward or overview at any altitude; cycle View button / V

movement.autocruise: Fly forward button controls thrust only
movement.collision: bounded low-altitude near-land sweep stopping at last safe sample

position.scaleChange: preserve offset relative to nearest destination or proportional open-ocean coordinates; do not respawn
position.userReportedUnexpectedReset: under investigation until physical browser reproduction

guardrails: third and fourth altitude preserve existing overview composition except requested centered planet lens
manual forward allowed even at highest altitude
camera changes must never change pilot coordinates/heading/momentum
do not call resetSpawn on world-scale change or collision
do not claim unexpected spontaneous reset fixed without runtime evidence
